name: Audiobooks vs Physical Books
instructions: Research suggests comprehension is broadly similar between audiobooks and physical reading for most material -- the format matters less than active engagement.
Audiobooks are especially useful for reclaiming otherwise "dead" time (commuting, chores, exercise).
Physical or e-book reading tends to make flipping back to reread or check something easier, which matters more for dense material.
Watch today's video for the full comparison.
